subject.title: chatCompletions: ignore request model when x-openclaw-agent-id header is present

question: Should a valid `x-openclaw-agent-id` header make the request-body `model` compatibility metadata, or must `model` continue to be an OpenClaw agent-target id even when the header is present?
rationale: The current code is internally consistent with the documented agent-first contract, but the reporter has repeated production evidence that standard OpenAI SDK clients send generic model ids and need an explicit-agent compatibility path.

options.title: Support header precedence
options.body: When a valid agent header is present, ignore generic body `model` values for agent validation and keep `x-openclaw-model` as the only backend model override path.

options.title: Keep current contract
options.body: Require clients to send `openclaw`, `openclaw/default`, or `openclaw/<agentId>` in the body even when `x-openclaw-agent-id` is present, and clarify the SDK workaround in docs.

options.title: Add an explicit compatibility mode
options.body: Introduce a documented opt-in mode or header for SDK compatibility, accepting the added API surface to avoid changing default precedence.

recommendation.title: Support header precedence
recommendation.body: When a valid agent header is present, ignore generic body `model` values for agent validation and keep `x-openclaw-model` as the only backend model override path.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent introduced and recently maintained the agent-first OpenAI-compatible model contract that this decision would change.
